groups.summary: Took a glass hero from a first study to a quieter, draggable interaction.
Polished keyboard movement, release behavior, and touch dragging.

moments.summary: First pass at the glass hero.

sources.text:
Playing with a glass lens over the headline. It magnifies and distorts the type as you move it.

First pass below. The rim and shadow still feel a bit heavy.

attachments.name: First pass
attachments.alt: Early glass study with a heavier lens over large black typography.

moments.summary: Blurred the whole supporting line after Sam’s feedback.

sources.text: This pass is much closer. The lighter rim and consistent blur across the supporting line make a difference. Let’s keep the glass still until I drag it.

attachments.name: Lighter rim and shadow
attachments.alt: Refined glass study with a subtle rim, softer shadow, and consistent supporting-line blur.

moments.summary: Shipped the draggable lens. Quiet until you move it.

sources.title: Make the glass hero draggable
sources.text:
The lens stays still until dragged. Refraction follows its position, with a lighter rim and shadow.

Applies the blur to the full supporting line. The recorded pass includes movement across both lines of type.

moments.summary: Scheduled a review of the glass interaction.
Move the lens with arrow keys.

sources.title: Move the lens with arrow keys
sources.text: Keep focus on the lens and allow arrow-key movement without scrolling the page.

moments.summary: Let the glass settle on release.

sources.title: Let the glass settle on release
sources.text: Ease out the last bit of movement on release, then leave the lens still.

moments.summary: Keep touch dragging inside the hero.

sources.title: Keep touch dragging inside the hero
sources.text: Constrain the lens to the hero bounds on narrow screens. Scrolling outside the lens stays natural.
A little glass study. Lighter at rest, draggable, with the type bending underneath. The last few details took longer than the first pass.

attachments.name: Glass interaction
attachments.alt: A glass lens moves across large black typography, magnifying and distorting the letters, then settles.
